tie_rule: earliest starting window, any true optimum counts correct
selection: Select first 9600 valid consecutive rows at or after file_day*86400+hour*3600, in source order. Within-second order is file order. Verify monotonic time per selected slice. Drop no high-latency rows. Fail on missing or malformed measurements.
metric: Compare nominal sum winner against full-resolution published TTFB. True regret = best sum minus chosen sum. For overlap use maximum common request count among full-resolution maximizers. Sum in ns over six requests, converted to ms for display.
cert: Certify regret <= delta if minimum nominal lead plus delta >= (q/2)*symmetric difference over ALL competitors. Loose comparator uses 6*q for every competitor. Record false certificates, coverage, nominal mistakes, loss quantiles and overlap. Primary delta=0; 1 and 8 ms are sensitivity points, not user-validated costs.
benchmark: Same batches for selection only and for selection plus certification. Prefix sums, no oracle or I/O in timing. Warm up both. Nine paired runs, alternate order. Report process wall clock ns per batch for each and paired median overhead.
review: On pilot and holdout separately inspect the smallest positive regret, largest regret and smallest overlap among positive-regret cases (break ties by row order; avoid repeats). Add two holdout controls: first exact certificate and first correct abstention. Report overlap as location, never as incident identity. Reviewer judges same incident and same triage from anonymized local timelines; no labels available initially.
interpretation: Describe sampled times and absolute counts. Adjacent batches in the same slice are correlated. No significance test, independent incident count, field benefit or production threshold inferred.
